about: Local corrections applied on top of OSM by scripts/build_resort.py for Tignes. Rule (as for Saint-Lary): where OSM and the official resort data disagree, the official data wins; names follow the official piste map. Evidence and open questions: docs/official-comparison.md (Tignes section).
officialSources: https://public.tignes.net/TIGNES.NET/BROCHURES/PLAN_DES_PISTES.pdf (official 'Plan des pistes Tignes - Val d'Isère 2026-2027', linked from tignes.net/ski/domaine-skiable/plan-des-pistes, file dated 2026-10-22; page 2 is the Tignes side. Piste labels are painted in the piste colour and read by eye on 5-8x renders, 2026-11-15)
https://tiles.openskimap.org/geojson/runs.geojson + lifts.geojson (OpenSkiMap export downloaded 2026-11-15; Tignes extract kept in data/tignes/raw/openskimap-*.geojson)
